main.description: ATSMS per-DID inbound-delivery record: where to reach this identity. A singleton (rkey 'self'), discovered with a single getRecord. Payload-agnostic — it addresses the DCGKA sealed-envelope path and the stateless one-shot path alike. Supersedes the retired per-device inviteAddress (inbound-delivery.md §3).

endpoints.description: Delivery endpoints ordered by preference (most-preferred first). A sender uses the first URI scheme it understands. At least one https: endpoint MUST be present, so that every conforming DID is reachable by a sender that speaks only HTTPS; a mailto: endpoint SHOULD also be present as the mail interop binding.

endpoint.description: One delivery endpoint. The URI scheme is the transport: https: = POST the payload (required), mailto: = SMTP (deliver as an application/atsms-envelope attachment, recommended). Unknown schemes are ignored by senders that don't understand them.
